# Citta Saṁyutta (SN 41)

**ID:** SN 41  
**Section:** Saṁyuttanikāya (sn)  
**Collection:** Sutta  
**Title (Pali):** Citta Saṁyutta  
**tipitaka.org (CST):** [https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/s0304m.mul6.xml](https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/s0304m.mul6.xml)

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

No reliable discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus.

**Parallels and text reuse**

- This file contains 10 suttas; 10 of them have known parallels. Full parallels by collection: SĀ (9)
- Examples of full non-Pali parallels: SN 41.1 Saṁyojanasutta ↔ SA 572 繫; SN 41.2 Paṭhamaisidattasutta ↔ SA 569 黎犀達多; SN 41.3 Dutiyaisidattasutta ↔ SA 570 黎犀達多; SN 41.4 Mahakapāṭihāriyasutta ↔ SA 571 摩訶迦; SN 41.6 Dutiyakāmabhūsutta ↔ SA 568 迦摩; SN 41.7 Godattasutta ↔ SA 567 那迦達多; SN 41.8 Nigaṇṭhanāṭaputtasutta ↔ SA 574 尼乾; SN 41.9 Acelakassapasutta ↔ SA 573 阿魯毗迦; SN 41.10 Gilānadassanasutta ↔ SA 575 病相

**Sources**

- [Bodhisattva Ideal 2013] Bhikkhu Nyanatusita, ed., Bodhisattva Ideal: Essays on the Emergence of Mahayana (2013) — Notes the association of the Citta Saṁyutta with the Saḷāyatana-vagga and the Vedalla category.
- [IABU 2012] 2nd IABU Conference, Buddhist Philosophy and Meditation Practice (2012) — Discusses animitta cetosamādhi and amanasikāra at SN 41.7.
- [Nyanaponika et al. 2003] Nyanaponika Thera, Hellmuth Hecker, and Bhikkhu Bodhi, Great Disciples of the Buddha: Their Lives, Their Works, Their Legacy (2003) — Details Citta's dialogues with Isidatta (SN 41.2–3) and Kāmabhū (SN 41.6), and comparisons with MN 44.
- [Anālayo 2019] Bhikkhu Anālayo, Mindfulness of Breathing: A Practice Guide and Translations (2019) — Discusses bodily, verbal, and mental activity cessation in SN 41.6 and its parallel SA 568.
- [Hazra 1994] Kanai Lal Hazra, Pāli Language and Literature (1994) — Summarizes the teaching on fetters and sense faculties in the Citta Saṁyutta.
- [Polak 2011] Grzegorz Polak, Reexamining Jhāna: Towards a Critical Reconstruction of Early Buddhist Soteriology (2011) — Discusses Pande's assessment of the Citta Saṁyutta's date and vedalla style, and nirodhasamāpatti in SN 41.6.
